digest.component_or_area: MCP secret infrastructure and deployment provisioning
propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY / /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key is an orphaned dead secret: it has a producer (SSM slot) and transport mechanisms (env file injection) but zero runtime consumers in application code or services.

The sole documented purpose of the secret (verdict signing) was superseded by asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates per ADR 0049; the current shipped verdict-signing path uses the op-cert key, not HMAC.

Removal is safe but requires atomic deletion across all producer and transport references (terraform slot, user_data.sh PARAMS entry, fetch-secrets.sh fetch and write) to avoid boot-time failures; rollback is manual but trivial.
Retaining the secret imposes ongoing rotation and restore toil on operators with zero security effect, and its presence contradicts the ADR 0049 migration posture.

The remediation spans exactly six tracked files (ssm.tf, user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh, adr/0012, gerrit-aws-setup.md, provision-restore.md) with one or two terraform applies and zero code/test changes.
